items.docs:
Sends an SMS, MMS, or messenger integration message to the designated recipient.

Parameters

Parameter
Description

To
Destination number or recipient identifier. Mandatory.  
- For messages via SMS or MMS: the destination number in E.164 format.  
- For messages via a messenger integration: the destination expressed in the format :, for example viber:Akj8ntzD7CVmB3Q7V2JqSB== or whatsapp:5552223456

From
Origin number or messenger integration ID. Mandatory.  
- For messages via SMS or MMS: Must

Gets the current status of a previously sent SMS or MMS message. Depending on the time of the request, network conditions, etc., one of the following statuses may be returned: queued, sent, delivered, failed.
